purpose: Teach: 花屋/満腹/ひく/きのこ/けんか/人参/レタス/貰える

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、駅前の花屋、本気で、絶対、新しいバラ、絶対、たくさん、本気で、入ってたよ、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Mom, the flower shop by the station had so many new roses. So many!
lines.style: Breathless with discovery. Quick, staccato bursts of excitement. Leans forward. Eyes bright. The rhythm of a child who can't wait to get all the words out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃんの料理、本気で、絶対、満腹に、絶対、なっちゃうわよね、翔くん、ね
lines.en: Mm-hmm. Your grandma's cooking always fills you right up, doesn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Soft affirmation with gentle warmth. Unhurried. A mother's half-smile in her voice. Acknowledging his excitement without matching it — steady ground.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、風邪、絶対、ひくこと、ないように、絶対、手洗い、徹底してるよ、ママ
lines.en: I've been really careful to wash my hands so I don't catch a cold, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet pride beneath the words. Serious and focused — he's telling her something he did right. Small, deliberate pauses. No rushing. Careful enunciation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、きのこ、絶対、たくさん、本気で、絶対、採れたって、聞いたわよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: I heard your grandpa got quite a lot of mushrooms this year, Sho. Quite a harvest.
lines.style: Conversational, connecting him to the family world. Soft curiosity in her tone. The rhythm of sharing news — not lecturing, just including him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達と、本気で、絶対、けんか、絶対、しないからね、ママ、約束
lines.en: I promise I won't fight with my friends, Mom.
lines.style: Solemn pledge. Slower than before. He's making a commitment — the words land with intention. Eyes meeting hers.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ぼくの好きな人参、本気で、絶対、夕食に、絶対、入れたわよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみね
lines.en: I put your favorite carrots in tonight's dinner, Sho. Something to look forward to.
lines.style: Gentle reveal. Warm conspiratorial tone — like sharing a small secret. Patient and unhurried. A gift wrapped in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: サラダに、本気で、絶対、レタス、絶対、ふんだんに、本気で、入っていて、嬉しいよ、ママ
lines.en: The salad had so much lettuce in it — I was really happy about that, Mom.
lines.style: Genuine, uncomplicated delight. Lighter tone, like he's sharing something that made his day better. Small smile audible in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、貰えるって、翔くん、楽しみね
lines.en: Your grandma's bringing you a souvenir, Sho. Something to look forward to.
lines.style: Soft promise. Warm anticipation. She's giving him something to hold onto — the tone is tender, almost conspiratorial. A gentle close.
